# alc-nn_topic

> # algocline — LLM amplification engine

## algocline 0.45.0

- [algocline overview](algocline/index.md): # algocline — LLM amplification engine

## algocline-app 0.45.0

- [algocline-app overview](algocline_app/index.md): Service layer sitting between `algocline-engine` and `algocline-mcp`.
- [algocline-app::pool](algocline_app/pool.md): Process-pool IPC layer for `host_mode=true` execution.
- [algocline-app::pool::client](algocline_app/pool__client.md): UDS client for connecting to a pool worker process.
- [algocline-app::pool::dispatch](algocline_app/pool__dispatch.md): Host-mode dispatch helpers.
- [algocline-app::pool::error](algocline_app/pool__error.md): Error types produced by the process-pool IPC layer.
- [algocline-app::pool::protocol](algocline_app/pool__protocol.md): Wire protocol messages exchanged between the pool client (MCP
- [algocline-app::pool::registry](algocline_app/pool__registry.md): Pool registry: persistent session-to-worker mapping.

## algocline-core 0.45.0

- [algocline-core overview](algocline_core/index.md): Core domain types and primitives shared across the algocline workspace.
- [algocline-core::domain](algocline_core/domain.md): Re-exports for domain types.
- [algocline-core::execution](algocline_core/execution.md): Pure execution service layer for `algocline-core`.
- [algocline-core::execution::cancel](algocline_core/execution__cancel.md): Cancellation and failure types for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::error](algocline_core/execution__error.md): Dedicated error enums for each `ExecutionService` verb.
- [algocline-core::execution::pause](algocline_core/execution__pause.md): Pause-related types for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::progress](algocline_core/execution__progress.md): Progress observation types for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::resume](algocline_core/execution__resume.md): Resume-related types for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::service](algocline_core/execution__service.md): `ExecutionService` trait — the primary verb surface of the new service layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::session_id](algocline_core/execution__session_id.md): Session identifier type for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::spec](algocline_core/execution__spec.md): Session specification types for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::execution::state](algocline_core/execution__state.md): Execution state types (v2) for the `ExecutionService` layer.
- [algocline-core::metrics](algocline_core/metrics.md): Metrics collection primitives.
- [algocline-core::pkg](algocline_core/pkg.md): Canonical projection of a Lua package's `M.meta` block.
- [algocline-core::recent_log](algocline_core/recent_log.md): Per-session recent-log ring buffer.

## algocline-engine 0.45.0

- [algocline-engine overview](algocline_engine/index.md): Lua strategy execution engine.
- [algocline-engine::bridge](algocline_engine/bridge.md): Layer 0: Runtime Primitives
- [algocline-engine::card](algocline_engine/card.md): Card storage — immutable run-result snapshots.
- [algocline-engine::execution](algocline_engine/execution.md): `algocline-engine::execution` — v2 execution module.
- [algocline-engine::session](algocline_engine/session.md): Session-based Lua execution with pause/resume on alc.llm() calls.
- [algocline-engine::state](algocline_engine/state.md): Persistent key-value state backed by JSON files.

## algocline-mcp 0.45.0

- [algocline-mcp overview](algocline_mcp/index.md): MCP (Model Context Protocol) server layer.
- [algocline-mcp::progress_forwarder](algocline_mcp/progress_forwarder.md): Progress forwarder task for the v2 MCP adapter.
- [algocline-mcp::prompts](algocline_mcp/prompts.md): MCP Prompts capability — workflow-trigger prompts.
- [algocline-mcp::req_registry](algocline_mcp/req_registry.md): `ReqIdRegistry` — wire-layer adapter exclusive mapping from `RequestId` to [`SessionId`].
- [algocline-mcp::resources](algocline_mcp/resources.md): MCP Resources catalog for algocline.

## algocline-nn 0.45.0

- [algocline-nn overview](algocline_nn/index.md): algocline-nn — thin candle wrapper for the `alc.nn` Lua surface.
- [algocline-nn::arch](algocline_nn/arch.md): Architecture presets for `alc.nn.preset.*`.
- [algocline-nn::arch::gpt2](algocline_nn/arch__gpt2.md): GPT-2 architecture builder.
- [algocline-nn::arch::lora](algocline_nn/arch__lora.md): Low-rank adaptation ("LoRA") wrap for a candle-nn `Linear`.
- [algocline-nn::card](algocline_nn/card.md): Card metadata schema for `alc.nn.card.*`.
- [algocline-nn::tokenizer](algocline_nn/tokenizer.md): HuggingFace `tokenizers` wrap with first-use download cache.
- [algocline-nn::train](algocline_nn/train.md): Training-side scaffolding.
- [algocline-nn::train::ckpt](algocline_nn/train__ckpt.md): Rotating safetensors checkpoint writer.
- [algocline-nn::train::data](algocline_nn/train__data.md): Dataset iterator abstraction.
- [algocline-nn::train::loss](algocline_nn/train__loss.md): Loss functions used by the training loop.
- [algocline-nn::train::scheduler](algocline_nn/train__scheduler.md): Learning-rate schedules for the training loop.
- [algocline-nn::train::fullft](algocline_nn/train__fullft.md): Full FT training loop.
